title: Grade 6 Math — Fri, Jun 20
description: Triangles & Quadrilaterals — Day 5 of 5: Mixed review
subject: mathematics

questions.question: A triangle with sides 4 cm, 4 cm, 4 cm is ___.
questions.explanation: All three sides equal → equilateral triangle.

questions.question: A triangle with angles 80°, 60°, 40° is ___.
questions.explanation: All angles (80°, 60°, 40°) are less than 90° → acute triangle. Check: 80+60+40 = 180° ✓

questions.question: Sum of interior angles of a quadrilateral = ___.
questions.explanation: The interior angles of any quadrilateral sum to 360°.

questions.question: A quadrilateral with exactly one pair of parallel sides is ___.
questions.explanation: A trapezium has exactly one pair of parallel sides.

questions.question: The diagonals of a rhombus bisect each other at ___.
questions.explanation: The diagonals of a rhombus are perpendicular — they meet at 90°.

questions.question: Third angle of a triangle when two angles are 55° and 75° = ___.
A triangle with one angle of 95° is ___.
In a parallelogram, opposite angles are ___.
questions.explanation: Opposite angles in a parallelogram are always equal.

questions.question: A triangle with sides 3 cm, 4 cm, 5 cm — type by sides?
questions.explanation: All three sides are different → scalene triangle.

questions.question: All sides of a square are equal and all angles are ___.
questions.explanation: A square has all angles equal to 90°.

questions.question: The base angles of an isosceles triangle are ___.
questions.explanation: The angles opposite the two equal sides (base angles) of an isosceles triangle are always equal.

questions.question: The diagonals of which quadrilateral are BOTH equal in length AND perpendicular?
questions.explanation: Only a square has diagonals that are both equal AND perpendicular to each other.

questions.question: A triangle with angles 60°, 60°, 60° is ___.
questions.explanation: All angles equal (60°) and all less than 90° → equilateral and acute.

questions.question: How many equal sides does a scalene triangle have?
questions.explanation: A scalene triangle has NO equal sides — all three sides are of different lengths.

questions.question: Consecutive angles of a parallelogram are ___.
questions.explanation: Any two adjacent angles in a parallelogram add up to 180° (supplementary).
